mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing fentanyl plasma concentrations and prolonging opioid effects; turmeric may also have mild antiplatelet activity and additive CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased opioid effects (excessive sedation, respiratory depression); consider fentanyl dose reduction if using high-dose turmeric supplements; counsel patient on avoiding concurrent use of high-dose turmeric products.
